_key.description: Genomic element key, the Ensembl ID of the readout gene and the source file accession joined by underscores.

enum: regulatory element effect on gene expression

p_value.description: Uncorrected significance statistic for the element-gene association. Meaning and scale depend on the source assay.
p_value.threshold: Used only when p_value_adj is missing/null: significant is true for p_value < 0.05.

p_value_adj.description: Multiple-testing-adjusted p-value when reported by the source.
p_value_adj.threshold: Used first when available: significant is true for p_value_adj < 0.05.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction
neg_log10_pvalue.threshold: Significance is evaluated on the corresponding p_value or p_value_adj after source-format conversion; see significant.threshold for precedence and cutoffs.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Adjusted negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction
neg_log10_pvalue_adj.threshold: Significance is evaluated on the corresponding p_value or p_value_adj after source-format conversion; see significant.threshold for precedence and cutoffs.

log2FC.description: Log2 fold change of readout gene expression for the perturbation.

log2FC_ci95_lower.description: Lower bound of a 95% confidence interval for log2FC.

log2FC_ci95_upper.description: Upper bound of a 95% confidence interval for log2FC.

pct_1.description: Fraction of cells in the first comparison group expressing the readout gene.

pct_2.description: Fraction of cells in the second comparison group expressing the readout gene.

significant.description: Boolean indicator of the significance of the perturbation effect.
significant.threshold: The adapter sets significant using the first available statistic: p_value_adj < 0.05; otherwise p_value < 0.05; otherwise abs(z_score) >= 1.959963984540054 (approximately 1.96). A present p-value takes precedence even when it is not significant. If all three are missing/null, significant is false. This labels significance and does not filter out nonsignificant rows.

effect_size.description: Perturbation effect size on readout gene expression. Semantics depend on the source assay.

effect_size_ci_95.description: Half-width of the 95% confidence interval on effect_size.

num_guides.description: Number of guides targeting the perturbed element.

fold_change.description: Fold change of readout expression in perturbed versus background cells.

background_corrected_fold_change.description: Fold change of readout expression in perturbed versus a matched or selected background.

gamma_approximation_ln_p_value.description: Natural log (ln) of pySpade Significance_score. Used to derive p_value_adj.
gamma_approximation_ln_p_value.threshold: Significance is evaluated on the corresponding p_value or p_value_adj after source-format conversion; see significant.threshold for precedence and cutoffs.

hypergeometric_ln_p_value.description: Natural log (ln) of pySpade log(pval)-hypergeom. Used to derive p_value.
hypergeometric_ln_p_value.threshold: Significance is evaluated on the corresponding p_value or p_value_adj after source-format conversion; see significant.threshold for precedence and cutoffs.

empirical_p_value.description: Empirical p-value from random background comparison.

cpm_perturb.description: Counts per million reads for the readout gene in perturbed cells.

cpm_bg.description: Counts per million reads for the readout gene in background cells.

num_cells.description: Number of cells with perturbation guides at the element.

z_score.description: Phenotype or effect z-score for the element-gene association when reported by the source.
z_score.threshold: Used only when both p_value_adj and p_value are missing/null: significant is true for abs(z_score) >= 1.959963984540054 (approximately 1.96).

idr.description: Irreproducible discovery rate for the element-gene association when reported by the source. Lower values indicate higher cross-replicate reproducibility.
